2608.30731.title: Calibrating Small Language Models for Claim Check-Worthiness Detection
2608.30731.paper_summary: Assessing claim check-worthiness is an essential first step in automated fact-checking pipelines. This work is motivated by a real deployment challenge at an early-stage startup: running large language models (LLMs) over every incoming claim is cost- and latency-prohibitive, yet smaller models sacrifice accuracy. We propose NN-PPI, a pointwise extension of Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) that calibrates model predictions at inference time as a lightweight post-hoc layer, without re-training the underlying model. NN-PPI achieves weighted F1 gains ranging from 12% to 33.80% depending on the size and performance of the baseline model, bringing SLMs on par with larger LLMs. Beyond few-shot SLMs, NN-PPI further improves a production-deployed fine-tuned model, demonstrating that residual calibration is complementary to supervised fine-tuning. By recovering LLM-level accuracy from models that are an order of magnitude cheaper to serve, it makes accurate check-worthiness detection substantially cheaper to operate at scale. Our code and data can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/arr-claim-worthiness-F237.
2608.30731.paper_summary_zh: 評估聲明的檢查價值是自動事實檢查流程中的一個重要第一步。這項工作受到一家早期創業公司的實際部署挑戰的驅動：對每個進來的聲明運行大型語言模型（LLMs）在成本和延遲上都是不可行的，但較小的模型則犧牲了準確性。我們提出了NN-PPI，這是一種Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) 的點對點擴展，作為一個輕量級的事後層，在推理時校準模型預測，而無需重新訓練基礎模型。根據基線模型的大小和性能，NN-PPI實現了加權F1增益範圍從12%到33.80%，使得小型語言模型（SLMs）達到了大型語言模型（LLMs）的水平。除了少量示例的SLMs外，NN-PPI還進一步改善了一個生產部署的微調模型，顯示出殘差校準與監督微調是互補的。通過從服務成本低一個數量級的模型中恢復LLM級別的準確性，它使得準確的檢查價值檢測在大規模運行時顯著降低成本。我們的代碼和數據可以在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/arr-claim-worthiness-F237 找到。
